_comment: German Whist locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action token '[play X]', the card labels (2..10, J, Q, K, A), the suit symbols (the {suit}/{trump}/{card} slots), or numeric counts/scores. The '(TRUMP)' marker text may be localized.

_slots.{trump_suit}: The trump suit symbol - do not translate
_slots.{trump_card}: The trump card label, e.g. 'K♣' - do not translate
_slots.{card}: A played card label, e.g. '10♠' - do not translate
_slots.{suit}: A suit symbol - do not translate
_slots.{max_pos}: The highest legal card position in the player's hand
_slots.{count}: A number of cards a player holds
_slots.{pos}: A card's position number in the hand
_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick or game
_slots.{remaining}: Number of cards left in the deck

game.start:
German Whist game started!
Trump suit: {trump_suit} (Trump card: {trump_card})

LEARNING PHASE: Win tricks to get the face-up card from the deck. The winner sees the next card, the loser gets it blind.

prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: Win tricks to get the visible next card. You can see what you're competing for!
prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: No more cards to draw. Win as many tricks as possible!
prompt.intro:
You are playing German Whist - Player {player_id}.
{phase_info}
Goal: Win the majority of tricks (14+ out of 26 total).
Card Power: A > K > Q > J > 10 > 9 > 8 > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 3 > 2
Trump cards beat non-trump cards. You must follow suit if possible.

Action: '[play X]' where X is the position (1-{max_pos}) of the card in your hand

trick.empty: No cards played yet this trick.

next_card.playing: PLAYING PHASE: No more cards to draw from deck.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Use [play X] where X is the card position (1, 2, 3, etc.)
invalid_move.out_of_range: Invalid card position. You have {count} cards (1-{count})
invalid_move.follow_suit: You must follow suit ({suit}) if you have cards of that suit!

action.learning_complete:
LEARNING PHASE COMPLETE! No more cards to draw.
PLAYING PHASE: Win as many tricks as possible with your current hand!
action.won_card: You won the trick and received: {card}
action.next_visible: Next card available (you can see this because you won): {card}

outcome.summary_head:
Game Over! Total tricks played: {total}

Final Score:
Player 0: {s0} tricks
Player 1: {s1} tricks
